name: lunch-webapp

dependencies.name: lunch-api
dependencies.description: All round, item, consolidated-order, and history reads/writes.

dependencies.name: team-auth
dependencies.description: Google Workspace SSO sign-in for teammates via the platform's Thunder identity service.

description: React single-page app for the team lunch flow: sign in via Google Workspace SSO, open a daily round, browse/add/edit/remove items before cutoff, close a round manually, view the consolidated order once closed, and browse round history. Holds no secrets and does not talk to Slack or the database directly — all of that is proxied through lunch-api.
